purpose: Aggressive performance probe for slow-pan motion refresh: very coarse color quantization and only the largest ownership regions.
expected_effect: Find the lower bound of global color refresh cost before implementing ROI refresh.
Keep only large color ownership regions to reduce connected-component and calibration work.
Test whether any global refresh configuration can pass the 100 ms p95 gate on slow_pan_far_object.
risk: This may be too coarse for final segmentation quality.
Use as a performance probe, not as a promotion candidate without visual review.
